51549843.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to BRD4 bromo domain 1 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.2. Affinity me: Affinities of derivatives of 1 (except the pan-inhibitor) were measured by Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC). Selectivity and affinities of the pan-BD inhibitor and its derivatives were measured by the BROMOscan technology platform services (bromoMAX and bromoKdELECT), provided by the Eurofins DiscoverX Corporation (Fremont, CA, USA). The BROMOscan platform uses a site-directed competition binding assay to quantitatively evaluate inhibitors against a panel of BDs and provides true thermodynamic inhibitor data (Kd values) over a range of affinities (<100 pM to >10 μM).
